verses.ar: طٰهٰ
verses.en: Tā-Hā

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِتَشۡقٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: We did not reveal the Qur’ān to you to (make you) face hardship

verses.ar: اِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰيۙ‏
verses.en: rather to remind him who has the fear (of Allah),

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ الۡعُلٰيؕ‏
verses.en: it being a revelation from the One Who created the earth, and high heavens.

verses.ar: اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ اسۡتَوٰي
verses.en: The RaHmān (Allah, the All-Merciful) has positioned Himself on the Throne.

verses.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ الثَّرٰي
verses.en: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens, all that is in the earth and whatever lies between them and whatever lies beneath the soil.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ تَجۡهَرۡ بِالۡقَوۡلِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخۡفٰي
verses.en: If you pronounce the word aloud, then (it makes no difference, for) He certainly knows the secret and what is even more hidden.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ لَهُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰي
verses.en: (Such is) Allah. There is no god but He. For Him are the Beautiful Names.

verses.ar: وَهَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ مُوۡسٰيۘ‏
verses.en: Has there come to you the story of Mūsā?

verses.ar: اِذۡ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوۡ اَجِدُ عَلَي النَّارِ هُدًي
verses.en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, “Stay here. I have noticed a fire. Perhaps I can bring you an ember from it, or find some guidance by the fire.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَتٰىهَا نُوۡدِيَ يٰمُوۡسٰيؕ‏
verses.en: So when he came to it, he was called, “O Mūsā,

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًيؕ‏
verses.en: it is Me, your Lord, so remove your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا اخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَاسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوۡحٰي
verses.en: I have chosen you (for prophet-hood), so listen to what is revealed:

verses.ar: اِنَّنِيۡ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدۡنِيۡۙ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: Surely, I AM ALLAH. There is no god but Myself, so worship Me, and establish Salāh for My remembrance.

verses.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخۡفِيۡهَا لِتُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: Surely, the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment) has to come. I would keep it secret, so that everyone is given a return for the effort one makes.

verses.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَنۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرۡدٰي
verses.en: So the one who does not believe in it and follows his desires must not make you neglectful of it, otherwise you will perish.

verses.ar: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Mūsā?”

verses.ar: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَيۡهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰي غَنَمِيۡ وَلِيَ فِيۡهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخۡرٰي
verses.en: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it, and I beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have many other uses for it.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلۡقِهَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: He said, “Throw it down O Mūsā”.

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: So, he threw it down, and suddenly it was a snake, running around.

verses.ar: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡࣞ سَنُعِيۡدُهَا سِيۡرَتَهَا الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: He said, “Pick it up, and be not scared. We shall restore it to its former state.

verses.ar: وَاضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ اِلٰي جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ اٰيَةً اُخۡرٰيۙ‏
verses.en: And press your hand under your arm, and it will come out (brightly) white without any disease, as another sign,

verses.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ‏
verses.en: so that We may show you some of Our great signs.

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Go to Pharaoh. He has really exceeded all bounds.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِيۡ صَدۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “My Lord, put my heart at peace for me,

verses.ar: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: and make my task easy for me

verses.ar: وَاحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً مِّنۡ لِّسَانِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: and remove the knot from my tongue,

verses.ar: يَفۡقَهُوۡا قَوۡلِيۡࣕ‏
verses.en: so that they may understand my speech.

verses.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ وَزِيۡرًا مِّنۡ اَهۡلِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: And make for me an assistant from my own family,

verses.ar: هٰرُوۡنَ اَخِيۙ‏
verses.en: that is, Hārūn, my brother.

verses.ar: اشۡدُدۡ بِهٖ٘ اَزۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: Enhance with him my strength,

verses.ar: وَاَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۙ‏
verses.en: and make him share my task,

verses.ar: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: so that we proclaim Your purity in abundance

verses.ar: وَّنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: and remember You in abundance.

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ كُنۡتَ بِنَا بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: You are certainly watchful over us.”

verses.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ اُوۡتِيۡتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: He said, “You have been granted your request O Mūsā.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً اُخۡرٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: And We had bestowed Our favour on you another time,

verses.ar: اِذۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.en: when We revealed to your mother what was to be revealed,

verses.ar: اَنِ اقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي التَّابُوۡتِ فَاقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِي الۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ الۡيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهٗؕ وَاَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّيۡ ࣢ۚ وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلٰي عَيۡنِيۡۘ‏
verses.en: that is, ‘Put him (the baby) in the chest, then cast it into the river, then let the river throw it by the shore, and it will be picked up by one who is enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ And I had cast love on you from Myself (so that you might be favourite of all), and that you might be brought up under My eye.

verses.ar: اِذۡ تَمۡشِيۡ٘ اُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُوۡلُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّكۡفُلُهٗؕ فَرَجَعۡنٰكَ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ ࣢ؕ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا فَنَجَّيۡنٰكَ مِنَ الۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوۡنًا ࣢ࣞ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِيۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلٰي قَدَرٍ يّٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: (Remember) when your sister was going (to the family of Pharaoh) and was saying, ‘Shall I lead you to one who nurses him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that her eyes might have comfort and she might not grieve. And you had killed a person, then We brought you out of the trouble; and We tested you with a great ordeal. Then you lived a number of years amidst the people of Madyan. After all this, you came O Mūsā, to a destined point of time.

verses.ar: وَاصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِيۡۚ‏
verses.en: I have fashioned you for Myself.

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ اَنۡتَ وَاَخُوۡكَ بِاٰيٰتِيۡ وَلَا تَنِيَا فِيۡ ذِكۡرِيۡۚ‏
verses.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not be slack in My remembrance.

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيۚۖ‏
verses.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh; he has indeed transgressed all limits.

verses.ar: فَقُوۡلَا لَهٗ قَوۡلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوۡ يَخۡشٰي
verses.en: So speak to him in soft words. May be, he accepts the advice or fears (Allah)”.

verses.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوۡ اَنۡ يَّطۡغٰي
verses.en: They said, “Our Lord, we fear that he will hasten against us, or will become (more) rebellious (against You).”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا٘ اِنَّنِيۡ مَعَكُمَا٘ اَسۡمَعُ وَاَرٰي
verses.en: He said, “Do not be afraid. I AM surely with you both. I hear and I see.

verses.ar: فَاۡتِيٰهُ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡؕ قَدۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلٰي مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الۡهُدٰي
verses.en: So, come to him and say, ‘We are the messengers of your Lord. So, let the children of Isrā’īl go with us, and do not persecute them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord; and peace be upon the one who follows the guidance.

verses.ar: اِنَّا قَدۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡنَا٘ اَنَّ الۡعَذَابَ عَلٰي مَنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰي
verses.en: Verily, it has been revealed to us that the punishment is for the one who denies and turns away.’”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَنۡ رَّبُّكُمَا يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Mūsā?”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِيۡ٘ اَعۡطٰي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰي
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “Our Lord is the One who gave everything its due shape, then guided it.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الۡقُرُوۡنِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: He said, “Then, what is the status of the earlier generations?”

verses.ar: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّيۡ فِيۡ كِتٰبٍۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّيۡ وَلَا يَنۡسَيؗ‏
verses.en: He replied, “The knowledge about those is with my Lord in a Book. My Lord does neither err nor forget.”

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا وَّاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًؕ فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰي
verses.en: (He is) the One who made the earth a cradle for you, and made in it pathways for you to move, and sent down water from the heavens; and We brought forth with it pairs of different vegetations :

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا وَارۡعَوۡا اَنۡعَامَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Eat, and graze your cattle. Surely, in that there are signs for the people of understanding.

verses.ar: مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَفِيۡهَا نُعِيۡدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً اُخۡرٰي
verses.en: From this (dust) We created you, and in this we shall put you back, and from this We shall raise you up once again.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرَيۡنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبٰي
verses.en: And We showed him (Pharaoh) all Our signs, yet he rejected and refused.

verses.ar: قَالَ اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: Said he, “Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your sorcery, O Mūsā?

verses.ar: فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ فَاجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهٗ نَحۡنُ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتَ مَكَانًا سُوًي
verses.en: We will, then, bring to you a similar sorcery. So, make an appointment between you and us for an even place, not to be backed out, neither by us nor by you.”

verses.ar: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ الزِّيۡنَةِ وَاَنۡ يُّحۡشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًي
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “Your appointment is the festival day, and the people should be assembled at forenoon.”

verses.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰي
verses.en: So, Pharaoh turned back, and put his plot together, then came.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسۡحِتَكُمۡ بِعَذَابٍۚ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ افۡتَرٰي
verses.en: Mūsā said to them, “Pity on you, do not fabricate a lie against Allah, lest He should destroy you with a punishment. And loser is he who fabricates a lie.”

verses.ar: فَتَنَازَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوٰي
verses.en: Then, they disputed among themselves in their matter, and kept their talk secret.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذٰنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُرِيۡدٰنِ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيۡقَتِكُمُ الۡمُثۡلٰي
verses.en: Said they, “Certainly, these two are sorcerers who wish to drive you out from your land, and do away with your excellent way of life.

verses.ar: فَاَجۡمِعُوۡا كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ائۡتُوۡا صَفًّاۚ وَقَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ اسۡتَعۡلٰي
verses.en: So, make your plot firm and come forth in one row. Successful today is the one who prevails.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُلۡقِيَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ نَّكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ مَنۡ اَلۡقٰي
verses.en: They said, “O Mūsā, either you throw (first), or shall we be first to throw?”

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ اَلۡقُوۡاۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سِحۡرِهِمۡ اَنَّهَا تَسۡعٰي
verses.en: He said, “Rather, you throw.” Then, suddenly their ropes and sticks seemed to him, due to their magic, as if they were running.

verses.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ فِيۡ نَفۡسِهٖ خِيۡفَةً مُّوۡسٰي
verses.en: So, Mūsā concealed some fear in his heart.

verses.ar: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡاَعۡلٰي
verses.en: We said, “Do not be scared. Certainly, you are to be the upper most.

verses.ar: وَاَلۡقِ مَا فِيۡ يَمِيۡنِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوۡاؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوۡا كَيۡدُ سٰحِرٍؕ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ اَتٰي
verses.en: And throw what is in your right hand, and it will devour what they have concocted. What they have concocted is but a sleight of a magician. And the magician does not succeed wherever he comes from.”

verses.ar: فَاُلۡقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوۡنَ وَمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: So, the magicians were led (by the truth) to fall in prostration. They said, “We have (now) believed in the Lord of Hārūn and Mūsā.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِيۡ جُذُوۡعِ النَّخۡلِؗ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَا٘ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. This man is in fact your master who has taught you the magic. So I will certainly cut off your hands and your legs from opposite sides, and will crucify you on the trunks of palm-trees, and you shall know whose punishment, out of us, is more severe and more lasting.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلٰي مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنَا فَاقۡضِ مَا٘ اَنۡتَ قَاضٍؕ اِنَّمَا تَقۡضِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَاؕ‏
verses.en: They said, “We will never prefer you over the clear signs that have come to us, and over Him who has created us. So, decide whatever you have to decide. You will decide only for this worldly life.

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰيٰنَا وَمَا٘ اَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ السِّحۡرِؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: We have put our faith in our Lord, so that He forgives us for our sins and for the magic you compelled us to perform. And Allah is the Best and Everlasting.”

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجۡرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَؕ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰي
verses.en: Surely whoever comes to his Lord as a sinner, for him there is Jahannam in which he neither will die nor will live (a happy life).

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِهٖ مُؤۡمِنًا قَدۡ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الۡعُلٰيۙ‏
verses.en: And whoever will come to Him as believer, having done righteous deeds, for such people there are the highest ranks,

verses.ar: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا مَنۡ تَزَكّٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: the eternal gardens beneath which rivers flow, in which they shall live for ever. That is the reward for the one who has purified himself.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي ࣢ۙ اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ فَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيۡقًا فِي الۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسًاۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّلَا تَخۡشٰي
verses.en: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Set out with my servants at night, then make for them a dry path across the sea (with the strike of your staff), neither fearing to be caught up, nor having any fear (of drowning).”

verses.ar: فَاَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُوۡدِهٖ فَغَشِيَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡؕ‏
verses.en: Then Pharaoh chased them with his troops. So, they were encircled by that (huge wave) from the sea which overwhelmed them.

verses.ar: وَاَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهٗ وَمَا هَدٰي
verses.en: Pharaoh held his people astray, and did not show them the right path.

verses.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ قَدۡ اَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوٰعَدۡنٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰي
verses.en: O children of Isrā’īl , We delivered you from your enemy and appointed for you the right side of the mount Tūr (Sinai), and sent down for you the Mann and Salwā :

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۡۚ وَمَنۡ يَّحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِيۡ فَقَدۡ هَوٰي
verses.en: Eat from the good things We have provided to you, and do not exceed the limits in it, lest My wrath should descend on you. The one upon whom My wrath descends certainly falls into destruction.

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهۡتَدٰي
verses.en: Surely I am the Most-Forgiving for him who repents and believes and acts righteously, then follows the right path.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَعۡجَلَكَ عَنۡ قَوۡمِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰي
verses.en: “What has caused you to hurry before your people, O Mūsā?”

verses.ar: قَالَ هُمۡ اُولَآءِ عَلٰ٘ي اَثَرِيۡ وَعَجِلۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضٰي
verses.en: He said, “Here they are just behind me, and I hurried towards You, my Lord, so that You be pleased.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِكَ وَاَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ
verses.en: He said, “We have then put your people to test after you (left them) and Sāmiriyy has misguided them.”

verses.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ غَضۡبَانَ اَسِفًا ࣢ۚ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًا ࣢ؕ اَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡعَهۡدُ اَمۡ اَرَدۡتُّمۡ اَنۡ يَّحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاَخۡلَفۡتُمۡ مَّوۡعِدِيۡ‏
verses.en: So, Mūsā went back to his people, angry and sad. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Did then the time become too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord befalls you, and hence you broke your promise to me?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَا٘ اَوۡزَارًا مِّنۡ زِيۡنَةِ الۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلۡقَي السَّامِرِيُّۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “We did not break our promise to you of our own accord, but we were burdened with loads from the ornaments of the people;so we threw them, and thus did Sāmiriyy cast.”

verses.ar: فَاَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوۡا هٰذَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُ مُوۡسٰي ࣢ۙۚ فَنَسِيَؕ‏
verses.en: Then he brought forth for them a calf, which was (merely) a body with a lowing sound. Then they said, “This is your god and the god of Mūsā, and he (Mūsā) erred.”

verses.ar: اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Have they not been seeing that it did not respond to them (even) with a word, nor did it have power to harm or benefit them?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هٰرُوۡنُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنۡتُمۡ بِهٖۚ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوۡنِيۡ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: Hārūn had already said to them, “O my people, you have only been led astray with it, and your Lord is the RaHmān (All-Merciful). So follow me and obey my command.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عٰكِفِيۡنَ حَتّٰي يَرۡجِعَ اِلَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي
verses.en: They said, “We will never cease to stay with it in devotion, until Mūsā returns to us.”

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰهٰرُوۡنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذۡ رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوۡ٘اۙ‏
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “O Hārūn, what did prevent you from following me when you saw them going astray?

verses.ar: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِؕ اَفَعَصَيۡتَ اَمۡرِيۡ‏
verses.en: Did you then disobey my command?”

verses.ar: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِيۡ وَلَا بِرَاۡسِيۡۚ اِنِّيۡ خَشِيۡتُ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِيۡ‏
verses.en: He said, “O son of my mother, do not hold me by my beard, nor by my head. I feared that you would say, ‘You have caused discord among the children of Isrā’īl and did not observe my advice.’”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يٰسَامِرِيُّ
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “What then is your case, O Sāmiriyy?”

verses.ar: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُوۡا بِهٖ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةً مِّنۡ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوۡلِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِيۡ نَفۡسِيۡ‏
verses.en: He said, “I perceived something they did not perceive. So I picked up a handful from under the footstep of the messenger. Then, I cast it. And thus my inner self tempted me.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاذۡهَبۡ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ لَا مِسَاسَࣕ وَاِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّنۡ تُخۡلَفَهٗۚ وَانۡظُرۡ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِيۡ ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفًاؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنۡسِفَنَّهٗ فِي الۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا
verses.en: He (Mūsā) said, “Then go away; it is destined for you that, throughout your life, you will say: ‘Do not touch me’. And, of course, you have another promise that will not be broken for you. And look at your god to which you stayed devoted. We will certainly burn it, then we will scatter it thoroughly in the sea.

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: Your God is Allah other than whom there is no god. He encompasses everything with knowledge.”

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرًاۖۚ‏
verses.en: This is how We narrate to you certain events of what has passed, and We have given to you, from Ourself, a (book of) advice.

verses.ar: مَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَاِنَّهٗ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وِزۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: Whoever turns away from it shall certainly bear a heavy burden on Doomsday,

verses.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ حِمۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: all such people living under it forever. And how evil for them will be that burden on the Doomsday!

verses.ar: يَّوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ وَنَحۡشُرُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ زُرۡقًاۚۖۙ‏
verses.en: The Day when the Horn (Sūr) will be blown, and We shall gather them together while they will have turned blue on that day,

verses.ar: يَّتَخَافَتُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا عَشۡرًا
verses.en: and will be whispering among themselves, “You did not remain (in graves) more than ten (days)”.

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِذۡ يَقُوۡلُ اَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيۡقَةً اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا يَوۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: We know very well what they say, when the best of them in his ways will say, “You did not remain more than one day.”

verses.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ الۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنۡسِفُهَا رَبِّيۡ نَسۡفًاۙ‏
verses.en: They ask you about the mountains. So, say (to them), “My Lord will crush them into dust thoroughly,

verses.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفۡصَفًاۙ‏
verses.en: then will turn them into a leveled plain

verses.ar: لَّا تَرٰي فِيۡهَا عِوَجًا وَّلَا٘ اَمۡتًاؕ‏
verses.en: in which you will see neither a curve nor an uneven place.”

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗۚ وَخَشَعَتِ الۡاَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ اِلَّا هَمۡسًا
verses.en: That day they will follow the caller who will find no deviation (from anyone). And the voices will turn low in awe for the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah). So, you will hear not but whispering.

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنۡفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهٗ قَوۡلًا
verses.en: That day no intercession will be of any use to anyone, except the one whom the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah) has permitted and was pleased with his word.

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيۡطُوۡنَ بِهٖ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they do not encompass Him in (their) knowledge.

verses.ar: وَعَنَتِ الۡوُجُوۡهُ لِلۡحَيِّ الۡقَيُّوۡمِؕ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمًا
verses.en: All faces will be humbled before (Allah,) the Ever-Alive, the All-Sustaining; and the loser will be the one who bears (the burden of his) injustice.

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا يَخٰفُ ظُلۡمًا وَّلَا هَضۡمًا
verses.en: But whoever does righteous deeds, while he is a believer, shall fear neither injustice nor curtailment (of his rewards).

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَّصَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡهِ مِنَ الۡوَعِيۡدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ اَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرًا
verses.en: And in this way We have sent it down to you as an Arabic Qur’ān, and have detailed in it some warnings in various ways, so that they may fear, or it may produce a lesson for them.

verses.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَقُّۚ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِالۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يُّقۡضٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهٗؗ وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ زِدۡنِيۡ عِلۡمًا
verses.en: So High above all is Allah, the True King! And do not hasten with (reciting) the Qur’ān before its revelation to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, improve me in knowledge.”

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اٰدَمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهٗ عَزۡمًاࣖ‏
verses.en: We had given a directive to ’Ādam earlier, then he forgot, and We did not find in him a firm resolve.

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰي
verses.en: When We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourselves to ’Ādam”. So, all of them fell prostrate, except Iblīs , who refused.

verses.ar: فَقُلۡنَا يٰ٘اٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقٰي
verses.en: So, We said “’Ādam, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not expel you from Paradise, lest you should get into trouble.

verses.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوۡعَ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَعۡرٰيۙ‏
verses.en: Here you have the privilege that you will not be hungry nor will you be unclad,

verses.ar: وَاَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَضۡحٰي
verses.en: and you will not be thirsty, nor will you be exposed to sun.”

verses.ar: فَوَسۡوَسَ اِلَيۡهِ الشَّيۡطٰنُ قَالَ يٰ٘اٰدَمُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰي شَجَرَةِ الۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٍ لَّا يَبۡلٰي
verses.en: Then the Satan instigated him. He said, “’Ādam, shall I guide you to the tree of eternity and to an empire that does not decay?”

verses.ar: فَاَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡاٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفٰنِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِنۡ وَّرَقِ الۡجَنَّةِؗ وَعَصٰ٘ي اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰيࣕۖ‏
verses.en: So, both of them Ādam and Hawwā’ (Eve)] ate from it, and their parts of shame were exposed to them, and they started stitching on themselves some of the leaves of Paradise. And ’Ādam disobeyed his Lord, and erred.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اجۡتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدٰي
verses.en: Thereafter his Lord chose him. So He accepted his repentance and gave (him) guidance.

verses.ar: قَالَ اهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيۡعًاۭ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ فَاِمَّا يَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ مِّنِّيۡ هُدًي ࣢ۙ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقٰي
verses.en: He said (to ’Ādam and Iblīs), “Go down from here, all of you, some of you enemies of some others. Then, should some guidance come to you from Me, the one who follows My guidance shall not go astray, nor shall he be in trouble.

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِيۡشَةً ضَنۡكًا وَّنَحۡشُرُهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ اَعۡمٰي
verses.en: As for the one who turns away from My message, he shall have a straitened life, and We shall raise him blind on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيۡ٘ اَعۡمٰي وَقَدۡ كُنۡتُ بَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: He will say, “My Lord, why did you raise me blind while I was sighted?”

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتۡكَ اٰيٰتُنَا فَنَسِيۡتَهَاۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمَ تُنۡسٰي
verses.en: He will say, “In the similar manner as Our signs came to you, and you had ignored them. In the same way you will be ignored today.”

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡ مَنۡ اَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۭۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: Thus We recompense him who exceeds the limits and does not believe in the signs of his Lord. Certainly the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ يَمۡشُوۡنَ فِيۡ مَسٰكِنِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Did it give them no guidance (to realize) how many generations We have destroyed prior to them in whose dwellings they (often) walk around? Surely, in this there are signs for the men of reason.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّاَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّيؕ‏
verses.en: But for a word from your Lord that had passed earlier, and an appointed time that had been fixed, it (the punishment) would have been inevitable (for them).

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوۡعِ الشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوۡبِهَاۚ وَمِنۡ اٰنَآئِ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَاَطۡرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضٰي
verses.en: So, (O messenger,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And in some hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at points of the day as well, so that you may be pleased.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ࣢ۙ لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي
verses.en: Never stretch your eyes towards the things We have given to some groups of them to enjoy, so that We put them to test thereby, it being merely glamour of the worldly life. And the bounty of your Lord is much better and more lasting.

verses.ar: وَاۡمُرۡ اَهۡلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاؕ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقًاؕ نَحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوٰي
verses.en: Bid your family to perform Salāh, and adhere to it yourself. We ask no provision from you. We give provision to you. And the ultimate end is in favour of Taqwā (God-fearing, and piety).

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا يَاۡتِيۡنَا بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ اَوَلَمۡ تَاۡتِهِمۡ بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الۡاُوۡلٰي
verses.en: They say, “Why does he not bring to us a sign from his Lord?” Has there not come to them the clear sign of what is contained in the earlier Scriptures?

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡتَ اِلَيۡنَا رَسُوۡلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزٰي
verses.en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before it, they would have said, “Our Lord, why did you not send a messenger to us, so that we might have followed Your signs before we were humiliated and put to disgrace?”

verses.ar: قُلۡ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡاۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰيࣖ‏
verses.en: Say, “Everyone is waiting. So wait, then you will know who the people of the straight path are and who has followed the right guidance.”
